component.name: Gungnir FM
component.summary: Fast dual-pane Linux file manager with Gungnir VFS

description.p: Gungnir FM is a high-performance dual-pane Linux file manager engineered in Rust and Slint. It is designed from the ground up as a native companion to Gungnir VFS, providing unified access to local filesystems, virtual filesystems, and remote endpoints.

ul.li: Full Gungnir VFS integration with live socket communication and dynamic GIO module
Instant dual-pane browsing, folder snapshots, and side-by-side comparison
100% bit-perfect lossless compression engine supporting Zstandard, XZ, ZIP, 7-Zip, Gzip, Bzip2, LZ4, and Brotli
Hardware-accelerated rendering across Wayland, X11, and Linux DRM/KMS Framebuffer
Low-memory footprint, non-blocking asynchronous I/O, and integrated package self-updater

description.p: Dynamic dark/light mode switching, reference-calibrated light theme, and native desktop drag-and-drop to terminal emulators.

ul.li: Interactive theme switcher with cool silver lunar crater disc in dark mode and clean sun glyph in light mode
Calibrated light mode palette using soft sky blue and cyan surfaces with high-contrast text and warm amber folder accents
Integrated Qt window backend for native OS-level drag-and-drop file path pasting into external terminal emulators
Synchronized Slint standard widget palette to prevent washed-out text on top menus and toolbars

description.p: Network sidebar integration, network:/// VFS browsing, and child process GIO environment isolation.

ul.li: Added dedicated collapsible Network section in the sidebar with network share icon
Implemented network:/// virtual filesystem URI scheme and RemoteVfsBackend support
Added isolated child GIO process environment to prevent backend recursion
Updated AppImage, Flatpak, and Snap packaging targets with integrated package self-updater

description.p: Nemo-style Properties dialog, XDG default application assignment, and external drag-and-drop integration.

ul.li: Added Nemo-style three-tab Properties dialog (Basic, Permissions, and Open With)
Implemented default application management writing to XDG mimeapps.list specifications
Added support for custom executable commands and system default reset
Enabled direct drag-and-drop of file paths to terminal emulators and external applications

description.p: Security hardening, CLI switch sanitization, permission isolation, and desktop launch optimizations.

ul.li: Sanitized CLI switches and delimiters across archive, transcoding, and updater routines
Hardened thumbnail cache directory permissions (0700) and user UID isolation
Optimized desktop launch entry with StartupNotify=false and StartupWMClass=gungnir-fm to eliminate cursor spin
Updated AppImage, Flatpak, and Snap packaging configurations with full Gungnir VFS bundling

description.p: Initial release of Gungnir FM featuring complete Gungnir VFS integration, Flatpak, Snap, and AppImage packaging, and automated package self-updater.
